switch_ports_added.note: UCIe lanes stay inside the two-die package

extra_circuits_on_existing_dies.die_variant: the 4 rank dies of each pre-group and post-group stage need a die master with +1 SerDes lane pair (2 PHY lanes) and lep_mu (lane face ~4.4k pins): 64 dies, a p4l variant
extra_circuits_on_existing_dies.note: +1 tx lane pair on each upstream rank die, +1 rx lane pair on each downstream rank die

reuse: per the token DAG of record (results/arch/token_path_20261009/ds_rom.json) every layer writes and reads its own rows on its own stage (own_row_write / window_load / pv nodes); what later layers reuse from the owner layers 2/8/14/20 is the top-k selection, which rides the stage h message with the user tag. So copy B needs NO reuse link; the owner copy is addressed by user only through the h message order. Lane MU-S81/SVC confirms on the RTL (svc_bases.json).

latency.copy_a: unchanged (the latency user is always on copy A: same dies, same circuits)
latency.why: every crossing is the same fixed-delay switched channel (377.6 ns budget), so copy B's hop latency equals copy A's; a copy-B user's windows are the copy-A windows shifted by its slot

groups.label: Stage 29: L19, L20.ffn
groups.placement: copy B trays in the rack row of copy A (S029), same switch plane set; cable <= the 27.6 ns budget share (~6.0 m twinax) like every other crossing
groups.rom: copy B dies carry copy A's ROM content: the same die masks fabricated twice (no new mask set); its HBM holds only copy-B users' KV / index state
